# Jagruti Appliances

> Jagruti Appliances LLP is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, making domestic flour mills (atta chakki), pulverizers, food processing machinery, automatic roti making machines and kitchen appliances since 1995. Every machine is manufactured in-house. Pricing, availability and delivery are confirmed directly with the sales team over WhatsApp rather than through online checkout.

- Address: Iscon Industrial Area, Plot No. 13-14, Lodhika Road, Ravki, Rajkot, Gujarat 360004, India
- Customer care: +91 70707 05922
- Trade / dealer enquiries: +91 95123 05922
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919512305922
- Email: info@jagrutiappliances.com
- Serves customers and trade partners across India; custom and OEM manufacturing available
